summary: Household: Louisiana; two children under 18; a 72-year-old father living in the home; the household owns its home. I could not get clear income, asset, or marital-status figures. Replies were inconsistent ("Good money, honestly", "None", "About 11 thousand", "Hard to say") across three attempts, so I cannot confirm eligibility for any programme. Not recommending any programme yet, to avoid a wrong application. A caseworker should collect: household work income per year, the father's Social Security amount, other income, savings and investments, whether a spouse or partner lives in the home, and whether the children or father have health insurance through a job. Likely programmes to check once those are known: CHIP/Medicaid for the children, Medicaid for the father (Louisiana expanded Medicaid), CTC/EITC if there is earned income, SNAP, and school meals.
